Summary This is a rushed out blog (not as comprehensive as normal due to my other commitments) simply to update all about the dire state in Warwickshire where nearly half of the libraries are due to close by 2014, cutting the budget by £2 million. It’s Gloucestershire, Somerset, Dorset …. all over again.
